description: This file defines the 'FormulaTranslator' class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for handling formula and address conversions from OpenOffice/ODS formats to Excel formats. It includes methods for translating cell references, ranges, and formulas between the two spreadsheet formats.

classes.name: FormulaTranslator
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for translating formulas and cell addresses from OpenOffice/ODS format to Excel format.

methods.name: convertToExcelAddressValue
methods.description: Converts OpenOffice cell addresses and ranges to Excel address notation.

methods.name: convertToExcelFormulaValue
methods.description: Converts OpenOffice formulas to Excel-compatible formulas, including reference and separator adjustments.
